text:
An wallafa Sa'a 1 da ta wuce Lokacin karatu: Minti 6 "An same ni a cikin jaka sanye da shuɗin kaya."
An rene shi a cikin iyali mai cike da ƙauna da kuma kirki a Belfast, David McBride ya san cewa an ɗauke shi a matsayin riƙo ne.
Amma sai da ya kai shekara 15 ya nemi takardar shaidar haihuwa don shiga soja ne ya fahimci cewa ba a san ainihin asalinsa ba.
Takardar ba ta da komai a ciki. An ayyana iyayensa na asali a matsayin waɗanda ba a san su ba, haka kuma an lissafa wasu bayanai kamar wurin haihuwarsa da ma ranar haihuwarsa.
Mahaifinsa da ya riƙe shi ya gaya masa abin da bai sani ba. McBride "ɗan kasuwa ne" kuma tun yana jariri an gano shi ya yi watsi da shi a kujerar gaba ta wata mota da ba a buɗe ba.
McBride da mahaifinsa tare suka yanke shawarar gano abin da za su iya. Sun fara bincike a ɗakin karatu na jama'a na yankin, suna binciken sassan jaridu.
A lokacin da aka same shi, shari'arsa ta yi tasiri a kan labarai saboda yadda aka yi watsi da yara ba a taɓa jin labarinsa ba a Arewacin Ireland a lokacin.
McBride ya bayyana cewa, Cocin sau da yawa yana ba da tallafi - ko kuma aƙalla matsuguni - ga iyaye mata da jariransu waɗanda wataƙila an haife su ne ta hanyar aure.
"Idan mace ta yi ciki ba hanyar aure ba, ana guje mata. Kuma matsalar ita ce [halayyar] ɓoye komai."
Yajin aikin jarida bai ba shi damar ci gaba ba, amma ya gaya masa cewa an kula da shi. "Na ciyar da kaina sosai kuma an kula da ni sosai."
Ya yi tsammanin mahaifiyarsa ƙarama ce kuma tana jin tsoro. Ya yanke shawarar nemanta.
Duk da haka shekaru da dama sun shude, kuma duk da bincike da kuma shiga cikin wani shiri na BBC game da 'yan foundlings, McBride bai sami amsoshi da yawa ba.
Sai kuma, bayan ƙarfafa masa gwiwa daga 'yar'uwarsa, ya yanke shawarar yin gwajin DNA.
Sunanta Helen Ward; amma maimakon ta amsa tambayoyinsa game da mahaifiyarsa, ta yi da yawa: ita ma an yi watsi da ita tun tana jaririya.
"An same ni a cikin jakar launin kore a cikin akwatin waya," in ji Ward. "Tunani na farko shi ne cewa mu tagwayen gasar ne."
Tasharmu ta WhatsApp Yanzu za ku iya samun labaran BBC Hausa kai-tsaye a wayoyinku.
Ba tagwaye ba ne. An haife su shekaru bakwai daban-daban kuma an same su a ɓangarorin da ke gaba da iyakar Ireland. Duk da haka kamanceceniya ta kasance abin mamaki.
"Wani direban babbar mota ne ya same ni," in ji Ward. "Jakar tana ɗauke da kwalba mai ɗumi da kuma kayan da aka canza. Na yi ado sosai kuma na naɗe ta da kyau."
Kamar McBride, Ward ta girma a cikin iyali mai ƙauna da riƙo, amma lokacin da ta zama uwa da kanta ta yanke shawarar cewa tana buƙatar gano mahaifiyarta.
Ta tuntubi wani ma'aikacin zamantakewa daga yankin da aka same ta kuma aka nuna mata takardar shaidar haihuwa makamancin wadda McBride ya fuskanta shekaru da suka gabata. Ta rubuta 'uwa ba a sani ba', da 'uba ba a sani ba', da kuma 'yar da aka gano a cikin akwatin waya.'
"Na yi matukar damuwa. Kana da tambayoyi da yawa - kuma yana da wuya a sami amsoshi."
Ward ta kuma yi bincikenta a cikin shekarun da suka biyo baya: tana ba da labarinta na sirri a wani shirin kiran rediyo, sannan ta sami ɗan sandan da ya yi magana da ita a shekarar 1969 da kuma direban babbar mota da ya fara gano ta.
Amma bayan da wata kawarta ta saya mata kayan gwajin DNA na gida ne ta sami ɗan'uwanta da ya daɗe da ɓata. "Abin mamaki ne," in ji ta. "Na ci gaba da matsawa kaina."
Da suka gama haɗuwa suka gane halayen junansu, abin ya yi musu matuƙar wahala.
"Da zarar mun haɗu, komai da ke kewaye da mu sai ya bayyana," in ji McBride.
Amma da aka kammala bincike ɗaya, sai aka sake ci gaba da bincike - don iyayensu.
Daga ƙarshe suka gano cewa mahaifiyarsu ta mutu tana da shekaru 90, ba da daɗewa ba suka haɗu. Mahaifinsu ya mutu shekaru da yawa da suka gabata.
"Mahaifiyarmu 'yar ƙauye ce. Mahaifinmu ɗan birni ne," in ji McBride. "Tana ƙarama sosai. Hasken da ke haskakawa ya kawo ta daga gabar tekun yammacin Ireland zuwa Dublin. Mahaifinmu shugaban ƙungiyar mawaƙa ne a Dublin. Ta haɗu da shi lokacin da wataƙila za ta je gidajen rawa. Sun yi soyayya da ta ɗauki shekaru 40 ko fiye."
McBride ya yi imanin cewa tunda soyayyar ta daɗe haka, dole ne su kasance cikin soyayya. Amma dangantaka ce mai sarkakiya.
Ya yi aure. Shi ma Furotesta ne, yayin da ita kuma Katolika ce.
A lokacin da Ireland ta rabu sosai tsakanin rarrabuwar kawuna a addini kuma har yanzu tana da ra'ayin mazan jiya a zamantakewa, David yana ganin kawai suna karya dokoki da yawa da aka haramta.
Duk da haka, akwai wani abin mamaki - Ward ta tuna da wani labari da ta karanta a tsawon shekarun da ta yi tana bincike, kuma hakan ya sa ta yi tunani: za ta iya samun wani ɗan'uwa?
"Labarin ya nuna cewa an sami jariri a shekarar 1965 a cikin akwatin waya," in ji ta. "Yana cikin jaka, da kwalba mai ɗumi. Don haka duk labarinsa wani ɓangare ne na labarina da na David."
Wata matashiya a Ostiraliya wadda ta kalli wani shirin talabijin da McBride da Ward suka yi tare game da bincikensu ta fara tunanin mahaifinta ɗan ƙasar Ireland, John. Sai ya zama cewa shi cikakken ɗan'uwansu ne.
"Shi ne yaron tsakiya," in ji Ward. "Lokacin da mu uku muka zauna muka haɗu, abin ya zama abin mamaki. Kana kallon iyalinka. Kuma tambayoyi dubu sun sake tasowa. Amma a wannan lokacin abin ya kasance mai ban mamaki."
Mun yi amfani da ƙirƙirarriyar basira wajen fassara wannan labari daga harshen Ingilishi. Ma’aikacin BBC ya sake duba labarin kafin a wallafa. Karanta ƙarin bayani kan yadda muke amfani da fasahar AI .
